A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an automatic representation learning algorithm for human activity recognition based on WiFi signals and demonstrate its feasibility and effectiveness in real-world scenarios.
we propose an effective device-free human activity detection system, SmartSense, which is based on a novel automatic representation learning algorithm.
SmartSense can achieve a high accuracy of human activity recognition with the help of existing WiFi infrastructure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SmartSense can be easily deployed in existing buildings without any additional hardware and infrastructure.
WiFi signals can provide sufficient information for device-free human activity detection, which can potentially be deployed in smart homes, smart offices and smart cities.
WiFi-based human activity recognition can be implemented without any extra hardware and the performance can be further boosted by automatic representation learning.
